Name: Ena Shinonome in Stardew Valley (DEMO)
Author: CherryDerry
Description:
Having finished her dream art school, Ena dives head first into the art industry. Unfortunately, not being able to find any other job, she is soon met with the horrible life of a corporation worker. Feeling burnt out, she decides to become a freelancer, and moves to Stardew Valley looking for rest and inspiration.

This mod adds Ena Shinonome from Project Sekai to Stardew Valley. The mod is still in development, as coming up with this many unique dialogue lines proved to be quite challenging. I've, sadly, already ran out of in game voice lines and convos :,)

This is my first Stardew Valley mod, and it won't be finished anytime soon, as I'm still learning what goes where in the code, but I'm hoping to give Ena heart events, add her to all the festivals and give her tons and tons of unique dialogue. Somewhere down the road, I'll rework her sprites too, as the colors don't look quite as I'd like them too. Turns out the laptop I made them on has a horrible display lol, and when I opened the mod on another computer, it all looked totally different.
